body: Magandang distinction ito: improving factories ≠ automatically improving equity returns. Sa Japan, today's tape makes that concrete—kapag sabay tumataas ang oil at discount rates, puwedeng gumanda ang orders habang lumiit naman ang valuation investors are willing to pay. Ang next confirmation I'd want is earnings revisions: kung margins and EPS estimates keep rising despite energy and funding pressure, mas durable ang growth thesis; kung hindi, PMI strength may be economically real but financially less valuable.
